race.comment: BOUDICA QUEEN (15) was only 2.5 lengths off at Townsville and with weight relief, she remains competitive if she can finish stronger. ZIG ZAG TORQUE (9) stands out with a solid mix of recent form and experience. Her fourth at Gordonvale was respectable, and her earlier run here was strong, finishing just 2.5 lengths behind Stable Investment. The 1.5kg claim and two placings from four starts on good tracks support her chances. DEVILISH DECODER (12) is a compelling debutante, equipped with first-time blinkers, an apprentice claim, and the strong Trevor & Peter Rowe stable backing her, plus a solid third in the Atherton trial indicating race readiness. SQUADRONS (11) comes in with less appealing form, but last start at Townsville was more forgiving after racing wide and this distance suits him better.
